slides.title: One year of your money, in a game
slides.text: You run your business and your home for 12 months. Every month is one level and one money skill.
points: Your real numbers from the survey

slides.title: Plan, get surprised, decide
slides.text: Each month has a mission. Something will go wrong mid-month: you decide how to handle it.
points: Mission: pay yourself, plan your budget
Alarm: a surprise you have to deal with
End month: the receipt shows what really happened

slides.title: Good decisions build your city
slides.text: Your home, company, cushion vault and protection grow as you play well. Debt cracks the walls.
points: Your year: one swipe to the left
Your city: one swipe to the right
Net worth: everything you own minus what you owe

slides.title: Myth or fact? Then make it real
slides.text: A quick swipe quiz checks what you learned. Then you add one real step to your own plan.
points: No points lost for wrong answers
"Add to my plan" = a step for your real life

slides.title: Habits that keep you safe in real life
slides.text: After the year you'll know how to keep a budget, build a cushion, protect yourself and grow your money.
points: A budget that separates home and company
A plan you can start tomorrow

tips.title: Your mission
tips.text: Three steps for this month. Tap a step to do it. It ticks off by itself.

tips.title: Actions and your numbers
tips.text: Actions on the left (more unlock every month). Your company and home money on the right, with where you'll end the month.

tips.title: Year · Learn · City
tips.text: Swipe or tap: your year on the left, your city on the right. This page is home.
